answers.brief_reasoning: IQR = 73-60 = 13. Upper fence = 73+1.5(13) = 92.5. 90 < 92.5, so 90 is not an outlier.

Write the 40 names on identical slips, mix them in a container, and draw 20. The 20 drawn take the weekly yoga class; the other 20 do not (control). Or label the volunteers 1-40 and use a random number generator to pick 20 different labels. Random assignment tends to balance other variables (lifestyle, baseline stress, and so on) between the groups. So the groups should be alike except for the treatment, and a difference too large to be due to chance can be credited to the treatment.
